objective: Maximize durable independent mathematics learning, transfer and misconception repair while preserving verified mathematical authority, privacy, offline operation and affordability.
invariants: LLM output is not mathematical marking authority.
No research claim without reproducible evidence artifacts.
Immediate assisted correctness is not accepted as a proxy for durable learning.
Research changes must not destabilize the 2026-10-04 functional demo lane.

priorities.title: Preserve 4 October demo lane
priorities.implementation: Keep research changes isolated behind branches/flags; prioritize stable end-to-end demo journey.

priorities.title: Productive Mistake Repair Tutor
priorities.mechanism: Convert verified first-break/misconception evidence into minimal Socratic repair actions before solution reveal.

priorities.title: Delayed retention and transfer experiments
priorities.mechanism: Measure independent learning after delay and on changed surface forms.

priorities.title: Pri Learner State v2
priorities.mechanism: Separate acquisition, fluency, retention, transfer, misconception persistence, method repertoire and help dependence.

priorities.title: Error-carried-forward and alternative-method authority
priorities.mechanism: Credit mathematically consistent downstream work after a bounded slip and accept verified alternate methods.

priorities.title: Physical handwriting and marking corpus
priorities.mechanism: Writer-disjoint real Pencil/photo evidence before OCR/marking architecture selection.

priorities.title: Teacher intervention copilot
priorities.mechanism: Evidence-backed intervention recommendations with inspectable counts and uncertainty.

priorities.title: Metacognition/self-regulation layer
priorities.mechanism: Prediction, confidence and explanation prompts tested for calibration and retention.

priorities.title: India-specific outcome evidence
priorities.mechanism: Prospective evidence across class, track, language, device and prior-attainment groups.

blocked_claims: Causal improvement in Indian student marks
